problem: Find $\,|\begin{aligned}x & 1 & 10 & 0 \\ 2 & y & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & z & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|$ given that $\,|\begin{aligned}x & 1 & 10 \\ 2 & y & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & z\end{aligned}|=8.$
worked_solution:
Notice that we have a block diagonal matrix. Therefore, its determinant is equal to the product of the diagonal blocks' determinants:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}x & 1 & 10 & 0 \\ 2 & y & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & z & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}| & =|\begin{aligned}x & 1 & 10 & 0 \\ 2 & y & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & z & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}x & 1 & 10 \\ 2 & y & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & z\end{aligned}|\cdot 3 \\  & =8\cdot 3 \\  & =24.\end{aligned}
$$
